findings.title: "Silence notifications" does nothing in the new list view
findings.body: `GrafanaRuleListItem` now passes only `promRule` (GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47), so `rule` is undefined here. `AlertRuleMenu` still shows "Silence notifications" because `canSilence` now ORs in the prom-rule ability (AlertRuleMenu.tsx:96, 126-131). Clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`, but the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, and that is false for an undefined `rule`. The click has no visible effect and no error. The new test in GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:194 only checks that the menu item exists, so it doesn't catch this. Either render a silence drawer that works from the prom rule (folderUid/uid/labels), or hide the item when no ruler rule is available.

findings.title: Pause and Delete no longer show in the Grafana rule list
findings.body: The menu still requires a ruler rule for these two items: Pause needs `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123) and Delete needs `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165). The list view (GrafanaGroupLoader and FilterView via GrafanaRuleListItem) now passes no ruler rule, so the new `grafanaPauseAbility` and `grafanaDeleteAbility` checks can never show anything. Before this change, `GrafanaRuleListItem` passed `rulerRule`, so users with permission could pause and delete from the list. The new test at GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:205-207 accepts this loss: it grants AlertingRuleUpdate and AlertingRuleDelete and still expects exactly 4 items. If dropping these actions is intended, the PR should say so. Otherwise, pause and delete need a path that works without the ruler rule (for example, fetch it when the action is clicked).

findings.title: Rule view link no longer includes `returnTo`
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` (GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx) built the link as `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })` with `returnTo = createReturnTo()`. The new component leaves out `returnTo`. Opening a rule from the list (including the filtered view) no longer returns the user to their filtered or scrolled list position. Nothing indicates this was intended. Restore `createReturnTo()` here.

findings.title: `// duplicate` comment and redundant ability evaluation
findings.body: The trailing `// duplicate` comment on line 289 explains nothing. `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility` and `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` each compute the full ability set separately. `RuleActionsButtons.V2` and `AlertRuleMenu` both call them for the same rule, so every list row runs `useFolder` and the silence-support hooks twice. Consider removing the comment and computing the abilities once per row.

findings.title: Redundant narrowing after `alertingRule` type guard
findings.body: Inside `if (prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule))`, `rule` is already the alerting type. `promAlertingRule = rule && rule.type === PromRuleType.Alerting ? rule : undefined` and the `?.` accesses that follow do nothing. The same applies to the `rule?.` optional chaining on lines 41-45, since `rule` is required. Use `rule` directly.

contracts.action: Silence menu item in the list view, based on prom-rule abilities
contracts.equivalent_path: Old list path passed rulerRule, so the drawer rendered from it
contracts.before_after: Before: rulerRule was present and SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer rendered. After: rule is undefined and the drawer condition is false.
contracts.visible_effect: The menu item appears, but clicking it does nothing

contracts.action: Pause and Delete abilities from the prom rule
contracts.before_after: The rendering checks still require rulerRule, so the grafana abilities have no effect in the list
contracts.visible_effect: Pause and Delete are missing in the list view

contracts.action: Folder lookup for prom-rule edit permissions (useFolder)
contracts.before_after: While the folder is loading, or if it fails to load, isEditable is false and abilities resolve to NotSupported
contracts.visible_effect: Edit and other actions stay hidden until the folder loads
contracts.failure_mode: If the folder fails to load, actions stay hidden with no error message

summary: The change moves the Grafana rule list onto prom-rule data and stops calling the ruler API there. Three user-facing regressions come with it. In the list view, \"Silence notifications\" shows but does nothing, because the drawer still needs the ruler rule. Pause and Delete disappear from the menu, because rendering still requires `rulerRule`. The rule view link no longer includes `returnTo`. The new tests check that menu items exist, not that they work, and they treat the 4-item menu as correct.
